scope: Actual PO initialization/persistence callbacks with in-memory storage; no browser or Firebase.

findings.trigger: PO cache already contains a non-array JSON value or truncated JSON.

observed.objectCache: initializer throws: .map is not a function
observed.truncatedCache: fallback [] is saved over original bytes

findings.impact: Opening PO fails before subscription starts, or discards recoverable cached bytes. Live authoritative Firestore records are not erased.
findings.limitation: Requires damaged/preexisting cache; no normal form input producing this cache was established.
